items.name: Composite Shortbow
items.description: This shortbow is made from horn, wood, and sinew laminated together to increase the power of its pull and the force of its projectile. Its compact size and power make it a favorite of mounted archers. Any time an ability is specifically restricted to a shortbow, it also applies to composite shortbows unless otherwise stated.

items.name: Shortsword
items.description: These blades come in a variety of shapes and styles, but they are typically 2 feet long.

items.name: Collar of Empathy
items.description:
This ornate collar of intertwined leather strips of contrasting colors is paired with a bracelet of a similar construction. When you wear and invest the bracelet and your companion wears and invests the collar, you gain a stronger connection to each other. You and your companion can always sense each other's emotional states and basic physical wants and needs.

Activate—Empathic Link 1 (concentrate)

Effect You perceive through your animal companion's senses instead of your own. You can Sustain the activation. You are unaware of your own surroundings for as long as you are using your animal companion's senses. In addition to the obvious use when you are separated from your companion, this ability might allow you to notice sounds, scents, and other stimuli that your companion's senses register but yours alone don't.

generalAbilities.name: Animal Empathy
generalAbilities.description: Eylthia can use Diplomacy to Make an impression on animals and to make very simple Requests of them.

defensiveAbilities.name: All-Around Vision
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

This monster can see in all directions simultaneously and therefore can't be flanked.

defensiveAbilities.name: Biting Snakes
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature ends its turn adjacent to the medusa.

Effect The medusa makes a snake fangs Strike against the creature.

defensiveAbilities.name: Mythic Resilience (Reflex and Will)
defensiveAbilities.description: The creature treats its saving throws with the associated save as one degree of success better than it rolled. This is not cumulative with other effects that change their degree of success, like the incapacitation trait (except for rolling a natural 1 or 20).

defensiveAbilities.name: Petrifying Gaze
defensiveAbilities.description:
30 feet. When a creature ends its turn in the aura, it must attempt a DC 29 Fortitude Saving Throw save. If the creature fails, it becomes Slowed 1 for 1 minute.

The medusa can deactivate or activate this aura by using a single action, which has the concentrate trait.

offensiveAbilities.name: Deadly Striker
offensiveAbilities.description: Eylthia deals an additional 1d6 precision damage on her next Strike whenever she uses an action to Stride 10 feet or more.

offensiveAbilities.name: Focus Gaze
offensiveAbilities.description:
The medusa fixes their glare at a creature they can see within 30 feet. The target must immediately attempt a DC 29 Fortitude Saving Throw save against the medusa's petrifying gaze.

If the creature was already slowed by petrifying gaze before attempting its save, a failed save causes it to be petrified permanently. After attempting its save, the creature is then temporarily immune until the start of the medusa's next turn.

offensiveAbilities.name: Mythic Power
offensiveAbilities.description: The creature has a pool of 3 Mythic Points, and can spend those Mythic Points for any of the actions it has.

offensiveAbilities.name: Mythic Skill (Acrobatics)
offensiveAbilities.description:
Cost 1 Mythic Point

Effect The creature attempts its next skill check with a +4 bonus and is considered to have mythic proficiency for that check.

offensiveAbilities.name: Serpent Venom
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 25 Fortitude Saving Throw

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 1d6 Poison Damage damage and Enfeebled 1 (1 round)

Stage 2 2d6 Poison Damage damage and Enfeebled 2 (1 round)

offensiveAbilities.name: Unimpeded
offensiveAbilities.description:
Cost 1 Mythic Point

Effect Eylthia automatically ends one effect that would give her a circumstance penalty to Speed. When she attempts to Escape an effect that has her Immobilized, Grabbed, or Restrained, she automatically succeeds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Vulnerability
offensiveAbilities.description:
Cost 1 Mythic Point

Effect Eylthia renews the vulnerability to her gaze on one target within 30 feet that is temporarily immune to Focus Gaze. The creature loses that temporary immunity.

lv3spells.name: Gravity Weapon
lv3spells.description: You build up gravitational force and funnel it into your blows, leading to more powerful attacks with blade and bow alike. On your first weapon Strike each round, you gain a status bonus to damage equal to twice the number of weapon damage dice.

lv3spells.name: Soothing Mist
lv3spells.targets: 1 willing living creature or 1 undead creature
lv3spells.description:
You call forth a magical mist that envelops a creature. The mist restores 2d8 Hit Points to a target living creature and ends one source of persistent acid, bleed, fire, poison, or void damage affecting it. If the creature is taking persistent damage from multiple sources, you select which one is removed. Against an undead target, you deal 2d8 vitality damage (basic Fortitude save); if it fails the save, it also takes (@item.rank) Persistent,vitality Damage damage.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing (or damage to an undead target) increases by 1d8, and the persistent vitality damage to an undead creature increases by 1.

lv3spells.name: Ranger's Bramble
lv3spells.description:
You cause plants in the area to entangle your foes, with the effects of Entangling Flora. A creature that critically fails the save takes (max(0,@item.level -1))d4 Bleed Damage damage in addition to being Immobilized. Escaping your bramble doesn't end the bleed damage.

Heightened (+1) The bleed damage on a critical failure increases by 1d4.
